mapper.insert: INSERT INTO baseline_remediation (tenant_id, result_id, host_id, rule_id, remediation_type, old_value, new_value, backup_data, execute_script, operator, message, status, start_time, end_time, create_time) VALUES (COALESCE(#{tenantId}, 0), #{resultId}, #{hostId}, #{ruleId}, #{remediationType}, #{oldValue}, #{newValue}, #{backupData}, #{executeScript}, #{operator}, #{message}, #{status}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, result_id, host_id, rule_id, remediation_type, old_value, new_value, backup_data, execute_script, operator, message, status, start_time, end_time, create_time FROM baseline_remediation WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, tenant_id, result_id, host_id, rule_id, remediation_type, old_value, new_value, backup_data, execute_script, operator, message, status, start_time, end_time, create_time FROM baseline_remediation WHERE result_id = #{resultId} AND status = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY end_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, tenant_id, result_id, host_id, rule_id, remediation_type, old_value, new_value, backup_data, execute_script, operator, message, status, start_time, end_time, create_time FROM baseline_remediation WHERE result_id = #{resultId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY end_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT br.id, br.tenant_id, br.result_id, br.host_id, br.rule_id, br.remediation_type, br.old_value, br.new_value, br.backup_data, br.execute_script, br.operator, br.message, br.status, br.start_time, br.end_time, br.create_time FROM baseline_remediation br LEFT JOIN baseline_result r ON r.id = br.result_id WHERE br.host_id = #{hostId} AND br.rule_id = #{ruleId} AND COALESCE(r.check_key, '') = COALESCE(#{checkKey}, '') AND br.status = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY br.end_time DESC, br.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, tenant_id, result_id, host_id, rule_id, remediation_type, old_value, new_value, backup_data, execute_script, operator, message, status, start_time, end_time, create_time FROM baseline_remediation WHERE result_id = #{resultId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY start_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, tenant_id, result_id, host_id, rule_id, remediation_type, old_value, new_value, backup_data, execute_script, operator, message, status, start_time, end_time, create_time FROM baseline_remediation WHERE result_id = #{resultId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY start_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, tenant_id, result_id, host_id, rule_id, remediation_type, old_value, new_value, backup_data, execute_script, operator, message, status, start_time, end_time, create_time FROM baseline_remediation WHERE result_id = #{resultId} AND status IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'ROLLBACK') ORDER BY COALESCE(end_time, create_time) DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, tenant_id, result_id, host_id, rule_id, remediation_type, old_value, new_value, backup_data, execute_script, operator, message, status, start_time, end_time, create_time FROM baseline_remediation WHERE result_id = #{resultId} ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT br.id, br.tenant_id, br.result_id, br.host_id, br.rule_id, br.remediation_type, br.old_value, br.new_value, br.backup_data, br.execute_script, br.operator, br.message, br.status, br.start_time, br.end_time, br.create_time FROM baseline_remediation br LEFT JOIN baseline_result r ON r.id = br.result_id WHERE br.host_id = #{hostId} AND br.rule_id = #{ruleId} AND COALESCE(r.check_key, '') = COALESCE(#{checkKey}, '') ORDER BY br.create_time DESC, br.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE baseline_remediation SET status = 'PENDING', start_time = COALESCE(start_time, NOW()) WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE baseline_remediation SET status = #{status}, old_value = COALESCE(#{oldValue}, old_value), new_value = COALESCE(#{newValue}, new_value), backup_data = COALESCE(#{backupData}, backup_data), message = COALESCE(#{message}, message), end_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE baseline_remediation SET status = 'FAILED', end_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
